data.content: Browser harness installed: Chrome 147 via Playwright Chromium-1217, Xvfb :99 virtual display, CDP on port 9222. BU_CDP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9222. To restart after reboot: start Xvfb on :99, then launch chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222, set BU_CDP_URL.

Book directory convention: All books in /mnt/usb_4tb/books/. Series get named subdirs. Book dirs contain source, build scripts, covers, EPUBs, PDFs, KDP packages. Loose files in _resources/, old backups in _archived/ at series root. Symlink: /home/bob/books -> /mnt/usb_4tb/books

USB 4TB drive mounted at /mnt/usb_4tb (UUID 5b794b72-6d5f-44ac-a97e-5978ee5220b1, ext4, nofail). Contains: /mnt/usb_4tb/backups/ (nightly hermes backups), /mnt/usb_4tb/archives/ (old backup dirs), /mnt/usb_4tb/books/ (book manuscripts/symlinked from ~/books), /mnt/usb_4tb/project-dirs/ (business, Developer, hermes, hermes-scripts, mifeco_web, saas, workspace-engineering -- each symlinked from ~/). Backup skill updated to write to /mnt/usb_4tb/backups/.
"Tomorrow Remembered: Through the past the future is born unwritten" — book directory at /home/bob/books/Tomorrow_Remembered/

Stream stall recovery: When a tool call fails with "Stream stalled mid tool-call", break the task into smaller sequential sub-tasks and execute them one at a time. For manuscript builds: split into small Python scripts that each handle one step (body HTML generation, TOC, CSS assembly, image embedding, WeasyPrint PDF). Use terminal heredocs for scripts, execute_code for small batches. Always verify image paths are base64-encoded before WeasyPrint PDF generation — file path references will not embed.
Bob's memoirs use third-person narrative ("Bob was six") throughout — NOT first-person. Direct quotations keep first-person as spoken. The books are written about the author, not by the author.
All 12 books have complete KDP directories. KDP upload via browser requires user to manually sign in to Amazon first — then agent drives the upload. Each book ~15 min.

Published author (Bob J Mills) with two sci-fi series on KDP: No Blue Sky (5 books — Built from Dust, The Oxygen Gamble, Rivers Under Mars, Red Charter, First Martian Nation) and The Lunar Foundation (3 books — Moon Rock, Mooncoming, Waters End, plus a 4th in progress). Also writes business/guide books. Communicates via Telegram. Detail-oriented: author name must be exact "Bob J Mills" (not variants), PDFs must have TOCs, fabricated claims must be reframed as honest case studies. Prefers compact series descriptions under 4K chars.

User expects leads to actually advance through pipeline stages when emails are "sent" — not just marked as sent in localStorage. Wants test/production separation: test mode writes to a mock inbox, production mode sends live via DreamHost SMTP. Frustrated when the dashboard fakes action without real effect. Wants the outreach dashboard accessible from mifeco.com/wp-admin.
